sec.title: Batch 93 Forensic Discoveries
sec.p: Batch 93 recovers and dates 13 historical broadcasts spanning baseball legends across eras, Hollywood cinematic icons, national memorial news tributes, hot jazz cornet recordings, and depression-era variety entertainment: Keith Morris interviewing St. Louis Cardinals pitching powerhouse Bob Gibson following his 1967 World Series championship, a rare wartime 1944 AFRS field interview with legendary Pittsburgh Pirates shortstop Honus Wagner, Joe Hasel's military sports roundup, New York Yankees Hall of Famer Phil Rizzuto and 1952 NL MVP Hank Sauer on ***The Inside Track*** (1953), John Wayne's passionate spoken-word patriotic narration 'America, Why I Love Her' from ***God Bless America*** (1973), CBS News' June 1969 retrospective obituary for *Dead End Kids* and *Bowery Boys* star Leo Gorcey, 3 Dixieland swing broadcasts from Red Nichols and His Five Pennies (1949), 2 hotel ballroom dance broadcasts featuring Freddie Martin and His Orchestra (1939), and Harry Richman with minstrel comedians Pick & Pat and 'Ukulele Ike' Cliff Edwards on ***It's Florida's Treat*** (1937).
